title: Luxury Sailing Boat Sina Dream - Sharm El Sheikh
overview: Experience a luxurious sailing adventure on the Sina Dream, exploring the best snorkeling sites in the Red Sea, including Ras Mohamed National Park and White Island.

stops.name: Hotel Pickup
stops.description: Pickup from your hotel and transfer to the sea dock.

stops.name: Sailing to Ras Mohamed
stops.description: Enjoy breathtaking views of the coastline as you sail.

stops.name: First Snorkeling Stop
stops.description: Explore vibrant coral reefs and marine life at Ras Mohamed National Park.

stops.name: Second Stop at White Island
stops.description: Travel by speedboat or zodiac to White Island and relax on the beach.

stops.name: Lunch on Board
menu: Salads & Sides: Fresh salads, Basmati rice, baked potatoes with curry sauce
Main Dishes: Egyptian Kofta, Pasta Napoli, chicken fajitas, fish in the oven, calamari, shrimp

stops.name: Leisure & Relaxation
stops.description: Enjoy the comfortable upper deck, sun loungers, and swings over the sea.

stops.name: Return to Hotel
stops.description: Arrive back at your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh.

includes: All transfers by an air-conditioned van
excludes: Fresh juice, Red Bull & ice cream
Photos taken by the cameraman (optional purchase)
extra_tips: Copies of passports are required for the trip.
Private bookings available for groups upon request.
